_readme: Token tree build_tokens.py reads. Each leaf is {type, value, source}. Values were read from computed styles on www.starbucks.com and the Auth0 sign-in wall on 2026-11-21. No custom properties were declared on :root (varCount 0). One light theme.

green.source: Measured: computed backgroundColor of the home order strip and body backgroundColor of auth.starbucks.com/u/login, rgb(0, 98, 66), 2026-11-21

greenLink.source: Measured: computed color of 'See the holiday menu' and backgroundColor of Add to Order and the Auth0 Sign in button, rgb(0, 117, 74)

greenDeep.source: Measured: computed backgroundColor of the Customize button on /menu/product/407/hot, rgb(30, 57, 50)

cream.source: Measured: computed backgroundColor of the home holiday panel, rgb(245, 241, 235)

white.source: Measured: computed backgroundColor of body on www.starbucks.com

black.source: Measured: computed color of body text and backgroundColor of Join now

ink.source: Measured: computed color of Sign in and product body text

nav.source: Measured: computed color of the MENU header link

fieldBorder.source: Measured: computed borderTopColor of #username on the sign-in wall

onAccent.source: Measured: computed color of Join now, Add to Order, and the Auth0 Sign in button

sans.source: Measured: computed fontFamily of body on www.starbucks.com. SoDoSans is proprietary; the guide uses the Helvetica fallback.

light.source: Measured: fontWeight of Start an order

semibold.source: Measured: fontWeight of Join now, See the holiday menu, h1

bold.source: Measured: fontWeight of MENU and the product h1

body.source: Measured: computed body style on www.starbucks.com

nav.source: Measured: computed style of the MENU header link, text-transform uppercase

heading.source: Measured: computed style of the home h1 'Holiday flavors are in town!'

display.source: Measured: computed style of the sign-in h1 Welcome back!

button.source: Measured: computed style of Join now and Sign in in the header

none.source: Measured: borderRadius of the MENU link and body

field.source: Measured: borderRadius of #username on the sign-in wall

pill.source: Measured: borderRadius of Join now, Sign in, and Start an order

order-x.source: Measured: padding-inline of Add to Order (18px 24px)

header.source: Measured: header getBoundingClientRect height on the home page at 1440

field.source: Measured: #username height on the sign-in wall

hairline.source: Measured: borderTopWidth of Join now and #username

banner.source: Measured: borderTopWidth of Start an order

order.source: Measured: boxShadow of Add to Order

desktop.source: Requested and measured viewport width of desktop captures (innerWidth 1440)

phone.source: Requested viewport width of phone captures

brand.source: Measured: home order strip and sign-in page background

inverse.source: Measured: Customize button fill; the product hero uses the same deep green family

primary.source: Measured: body color on the home page

ink.source: Measured: product body and Sign in label

onBrand.source: Measured: color of text on the green order strip and green buttons

default.source: Measured: border color of the Sign in pill

accent.source: Measured: border color of See the holiday menu

field.source: Measured: border color of the email field on the sign-in wall

brand.source: Measured: Add to Order and Auth0 Sign in backgrounds

banner.source: Measured: Start an order background, which matches the strip

ring.source: Not captured as a keyboard ring. The email field's computed box-shadow uses rgba(0, 117, 74, 0.23); a dedicated focus-visible ring was not isolated. Recorded as the accent, with this gap.
